description.value: The Bonniebrook Lodge is the Sunshine Coast's oldest and longest-running accommodation provider, an oceanfront heritage inn in Gibsons with roots going back nearly a century. Rated 4.5 stars (Inn category) by Canada Select, it occupies a dramatic shoreline setting with views over the Strait of Georgia. The on-site Chasters Restaurant is a well-regarded fine-dining destination offering seasonal farm-to-table menus, making it a notable overnight stop for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast.

address.value: 1532 Ocean Beach Esplanade, Gibsons, BC V0N 1V5
